passages.provision_quote: The Secretary of the California Health and Human Services Agency shall research, develop, and pursue discussions of a waiver framework in consultation with the federal government with the objective of creating a health care system that incorporates the following features and objectives:
passages.note: The operative sections only direct research and waiver-framework discussions toward unified financing; this is a study-directive, not an enactment of any rung.
Final floor vote on the same study-directive instrument; the vote cannot prove a chair because the bill itself only orders research and discussions.

rows.reasoning: SB 770, which Wiener authored and signed into law, only directs the Secretary of CHHS to research, pursue waiver discussions, and report on a possible unified financing system; it is a study-directive under V4 and cannot establish any rung, so no passage supports a chair.
needs_source: an enacted single-payer or unified health care financing law (not a waiver-framework study), or Wiener's own words answering what role government should play in healthcare access
